preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line.split()), list) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit())
preconditions.description: Each friend list line contains space-separated integers representing friend labels.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line) > 0)
preconditions.description: Each friend label is a positive integer between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(friends) >= 1 for friends in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each friend has at least one friend in their list.

preconditions.expression: all(friend not in friends for friends in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()] for friend in friends)
preconditions.description: No friend is in their own friend list.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line) > 0 and int(line) <= 100)
preconditions.description: Number of friends in a group is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line) > 0 and int(line) <= 100)
preconditions.description: Number of groups is at most 100.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == 2 for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly two space-separated values: the most popular friend label and the average distance.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line.split()[0].isdigit() for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: The first value in each output line is a valid friend label.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= float(output_line.split()[1]) <= 100 for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: The second value in each output line is a valid average distance between 0 and 100.

postconditions.expression: all('{:.6f}'.format(float(output_line.split()[1])) == output_line.split()[1] for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: The average distance is printed with exactly six decimal places.

postconditions.expression: all(min([(sum(distances[friend]) / len(distances[friend]), friend) for friend in friends])[1] == int(output_line.split()[0]) for friends, output_line in zip([line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()], stdout.splitlines()) if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: The most popular friend is the one with the least average distance (notoriety) from all other friends in the group. In case of a tie, the friend with the smallest label is chosen.

postconditions.expression: all(float(output_line.split()[1]) == sum(distances[most_popular_friend]) / len(distances[most_popular_friend]) for friends, output_line in zip([line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()], stdout.splitlines()) if output_line.strip() for most_popular_friend in [min([(sum(distances[friend]) / len(distances[friend]), friend) for friend in friends])[1]] for distances in [compute_distances(friends)])
postconditions.description: The average distance is correctly computed as the average of distances from all friends to the most popular friend.
